meta.description: A simulated investing hub with a traceable agent. Simulation only: no real transactions, no investment advice.

hero.title: Try out your investing ideas, with no real money.
hero.lead: A profile computed from rules, example portfolios, strategies replayed on past data, and an agent that logs every step. Simulation only: no real transactions, no investment advice.
hero.note: No account needed, no real money.

profile.title: Profile and suggested portfolios
profile.body: A short questionnaire computes your level and risk profile with versioned rules. You then see a few example portfolios, with every line explained.

strategy.title: Rule-based strategy
strategy.body: Build a strategy from rule cards: weight cap, rebalancing, drawdown guard, periodic contributions. Every change shows as a preview first.

timeMachine.title: Time machine
timeMachine.body: Replay a portfolio on frozen historical data, with and without your strategy, side by side. The comparison stays on screen even when the rules do worse.

agent.title: Traceable agent
agent.body: Ask in French or English. The agent proposes structured changes, and every step, tool and source goes into a log that cannot be rewritten.
